responsibility: This file provides the core RTL construction and instruction-chain manipulation services used by the expander and later RTL generation code. It owns global and per-function RTL state, canonical caches for constants and register attributes, creation and copying of insns and RTL objects, instruction location tracking, label numbering, common constant RTX objects, and low-level helpers such as atomic-barrier classification and shift-amount construction that underpin all RTL emission.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for core RTL construction in the `emit-rtl` group: it owns RTL state, caches, insn-chain manipulation, and low-level emit helpers, while `gcc/emit-rtl.h` provides the corresponding declarations and data layouts.
